verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe ingesting text, files, and URLs via a single `.remember` call, plus integrations for Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Google Drive and code indexing, going well beyond chat transcripts; a runtime probe confirms the CLI can load and query a knowledge graph locally.
